title: WeLM-Image: A Unified Image Generation Model towards Visual Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2611.07392v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present \textbf{WeLM-Image}, a unified image foundation model that integrates multimodal understanding into text-to-image generation, instruction-guided editing, and multi-reference synthesis. Designed for single-GPU deployment in WeChat's large-scale consumer applications, the model processes text, reference images, and target latents as one interleaved sequence. A Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone combines shared attention with independent understanding and generation parameters to limit optimization interference. Equipping each path with Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) modules provides sparse capacity, with 31.7B stored parameters and approximately 5.4B generation parameters activated per target latent token. A generation-oriented data engine combines a knowledge-grounded visual vocabulary with large-scale visual clustering to balance semantic coverage and editing tasks, while training-time evaluation guides iterative data refineme

translated_title: WeLM-Image：面向视觉智能的统一图像生成模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了WeLM-Image，这是一个统一的图像基础模型，将多模态理解融入文本生成图像、指令引导编辑和多参考图像合成之中。该模型专为微信大规模消费级应用中的单GPU部署而设计，将文本、参考图像和目标潜变量作为一个交错的序列进行处理。其混合Transformer骨干网络将共享注意力与相互独立的理解和生成参数相结合，以限制优化过程中的相互干扰。每条路径均配备混合专家模块以提供稀疏容量，总存储参数达317亿，每个目标潜变量token仅激活约54亿生成参数。一个面向生成的数据引擎将基于知识的视觉词汇表与大规模视觉聚类相结合，以平衡语义覆盖与编辑任务，同时通过训练时评估指导迭代式数据精炼。
tldr: WeLM-Image是一个面向大规模消费级应用单GPU部署的统一图像生成基础模型，通过混合Transformer骨干与稀疏混合专家架构将多模态理解融入文本生成图像、指令引导编辑和多参考合成三类任务。
en_tdlr: WeLM-Image is a unified image foundation model designed for single-GPU deployment in large-scale consumer applications, which integrates multimodal understanding into text-to-image generation, instruction-guided editing, and multi-reference synthesis through a Mixture-of-Transformers backbone with sparse MoE modules.
